name: SLIME
hint: The slime coat covers the ball in springy green goo. Acid pools drop at midcourt.

name: SKELETON
hint: Arrows have a 50% chance to stun or deal damage. Its guard lasts through returns.

name: WRAITH
hint: The Wraith phase-steps to intercept balls. Watch for subtle ghostly tremors on decoys.

name: NECROMANCER
hint: Bone spires erupt when you strike the ball. Break them before they reanimate!

name: BONE KING
hint: Guard → arrow volleys → bone spires. Block arrows carefully; splinters fly back.

name: THE MASON
hint: One-sided fortress wall: Mason's shots pass through, yours bounce! Watch for flying rubble.

name: THE HUNTER
hint: Locks a sniper laser before firing rapid bolts. Guaranteed damage unless 50% reflected!

name: THE TWINS
hint: Two balls and coordinated dual defenders. One covers high, one covers low.

name: GATEKEEPER
hint: Drifting Warp Rifts in mid-court bend ball trajectories. No yellow arrows here!

name: PHANTOM QUEEN
hint: Phase 1: aimed shots. Phase 2: 5-shot fan + decoys. Phase 3: portals + phase steps.

name: CHORISTER
hint: Harmonic lane waves sweep the arena. The ball accelerates with every 5 returns!

name: DREAM EATER
hint: Nightmare gravity bends the ball downward. Sleep stasis traps freeze balls mid-air before erratic releases!

name: THE ALIEN
hint: Extraterrestrial squad! UFO tractor beams capture and slingshot balls. Orbiting drones protect the squad.

name: THE VOID
hint: Survive 35 s. A gravitational singularity at center bends all balls and projectiles.

name: BULLET SAINT
hint: Bank the white ball into the open core window. Lanes escalate each phase.

name: ZEUS
hint: Olympian god! Fast chain lightning strikes stun and electrify hyper-charged balls.

name: THE VAULT
hint: Destroy all 4 blocks first. Every enemy return kicks the ball at a random angle.

name: TWIN GATES
hint: Two balls in a portal court. Each portal transit speeds the ball up by 8%.

name: THE REFLECTION
hint: You play from the right side. Top-wall bounces teleport the ball to a random height.

name: LORD 666
hint: Arch-Demon of the Underworld! Pentagram hellfire arena, homing skull volleys, and magma eruptions.

name: THE ANGEL
hint: Divine Seraph! Sweeping vertical pillars of holy light and spinning sacred feather daggers.

name: LEVIATHAN
hint: Deep Ocean Behemoth! Fluid drift currents and swirling whirlpool vortexes drag the ball into spirals.

name: NIRVANA
hint: Celestial mandala stasis field refracts balls into Yin-Yang duality. Karmic resonance rings on every hit.

name: THE COSMOS
hint: Cosmic gravity distortion and hyper-speed warp portals cross-linking across deep space.

name: THE ARCHITECT
hint: The Apex Reality Shaper! Five escalating phases combining all cosmic dimensions into an epic finale.
